teaching.example: I put honey on my bread.
teaching.student_prompt: 说说蜜蜂带来的食物：Bees make honey。
teaching.note: 原创 KET 课堂例句；先读单词与例句，再学习构词或常用搭配。

word_study.explanation_zh: honey 整体记，不把 -ey 当词缀。它能和 bee 组成 honeybee，也能和 comb 组成 honeycomb。

example.en: A honeybee is on the flower.

family.connection_zh: honey + comb；这里 comb 指蜂巢的格子结构。

challenge.prompt_zh: honey 和 bee 可以组成哪个词？

images.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather / composition edit.
Input image: edit target. Preserve the same golden honey jar, bread, wooden dipper, realistic textures and beautiful warm natural daylight. Extend the photograph horizontally to a LANDSCAPE 3:2 composition suitable for a classroom slide, adding clean tabletop and softly blurred breakfast background on the two sides. Keep the full honey jar visible with margin; no new subjects, text, logos or labels. Final output must be wider than tall, ideally 1536x1024.

generation_history.prompt: undefinedPrimary request: A beautiful close-up of a clear unlabelled glass jar of golden honey on a light wooden breakfast table. A wooden honey dipper held just above the open jar makes one glossy thread of honey flow back into it; a slice of bread with a little honey rests nearby. Sunlight glows through the amber honey. Real food photography with convincing viscous texture. No bees, no people, no labels.
